limitations: The existing eleven structure groups have the same source element geometry counts in 4.0 and this 4.3 export; this export must not be advertised as higher-resolution solely from its version.
Ventricular wall remains a combined mesh. No separately modeled atrial/ventricular septum, chordae tendineae, atrial cavity or conduction system was found in the selected manifest.
Surface cavities are space representations, not myocardium. Valve models are static; motion and hemodynamics are not validated.
Reference adult male anatomy; medical expert review of this selection and Chinese terminology remains pending.
